_meta.name: English
_meta.note: Source language. Every key of every other table must exist here; placeholders ({n}, {score}...) and plural categories follow tools/check-strings.py.

quit.title: QUIT GAME?
quit.body: The track will be waiting. Leave BeamRunner for now?
rate_prompt.title: RATE BEAMRUNNER
rate_prompt.body: Having fun? A quick rating on the store helps other pilots find the game. It only takes a moment.
reminder_offer.title: DAILY REMINDERS
reminder_offer.body: Want a nudge when your next daily reward is ready? One evening reminder at most, never at night. You can switch it off any time in Settings.
toast.reminders_on: Reminders on. See you tomorrow, pilot!
toast.reminders_off: Reminders are off. Turn them on in Settings.
consent.title: YOUR PRIVACY
consent.body: BeamRunner is free thanks to a few optional ads. Personalised ads are picked for you using data about your device and activity; non-personalised ads use no such data. You can change this any time in Settings.
consent.body_crash: BeamRunner is free thanks to a few optional ads. Personalised ads are picked for you using data about your device and activity; non-personalised ads use no such data. You can change this any time in Settings. Crash reports (what went wrong, device model and OS, no personal details) help us fix bugs.
store.title: GEM STORE
store.unavailable_body: Check your connection and try again. Anything you've already bought is safe.
store.remove_ads_body: No more interstitial ads between runs. Rewarded ads stay optional.
ship.shuttle_tagline: Where it all began. Retro-fitted with neon.
ship.viper_tagline: Needle nose built for the redline.
ship.halo_tagline: A ring of light that never sleeps.

ship.eclipse_tagline: Swallows the light, keeps the fire.
ship.wraith_tagline: Pale as frost, gone before you look.
ship.solaris_tagline: Polished by pilots who kept coming back.

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.graphics_hint: Lower settings save battery and keep older phones smooth.

settings.personalised_hint: Off: you'll still see ads, just less relevant ones.
settings.crash_hint: What went wrong, device model and OS. No personal details.
settings.reminders_hint: One evening nudge when your daily reward is ready. Never at night.
settings.reminders_blocked_hint: Notifications are blocked for BeamRunner in your system settings.
settings.blocked_body: BeamRunner isn't allowed to send notifications. Allow them in your device's settings, then turn {setting} on here.
settings.purchases_hint: Bought Remove Ads on another device? Restore it here.
settings.support_hint: Found a bug or have an idea? We'd love to hear from you.
settings.credit_fonts: Fonts: Audiowide, Rajdhani, Russo One, Tektur, Noto Sans JP/KR/SC — SIL Open Font License
settings.credit_generated: Music, sound, art and code generated procedurally
settings.danger_hint: Erases gems, ships, missions and records. Purchases and settings are kept.
settings.reset_body: This erases your gems, ships, missions, achievements and records. Purchases and settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
toast.reminders_permission: Reminders need permission to send notifications.
online.title: ONLINE
online.sign_in_hint: Sign in for leaderboards, achievements and cloud save.
online.not_signed_in_game_center: Not signed in. Sign in to Game Center in the iOS Settings app.
online.cloud_synced: Your progress is saved in the cloud. Last synced {ago}.
online.cloud_offline: Could not reach the cloud. Your progress is safe on this device and syncs again later.
online.cloud_conflict: The cloud save of this account belongs to other progress. Tap {button} to combine them.
online.cloud_needs_update: The cloud has progress from a newer version of the game. Update to sync everything.
online.cloud_needs_sign_in: Sign in to keep your progress in the cloud.
online.combine_body: The cloud save of the signed-in account holds different progress than this device. Combine both? Nothing is lost: ships, achievements, records and gems from both are kept.
toast.sync_failed: Couldn't reach the cloud. Try again later.
